pit_classification.retrieved_at: timezone-aware time Axiom observed the response
pit_classification.represented_session: the supplier date field named by the endpoint
pit_classification.historical_availability: unknown unless the row carries separately verified availability evidence
pit_classification.revision_capability: current terminal-history observation; revision history and original visibility are not guaranteed

field_mapping.normal_active: presence of a valid daily row

daily.missing_semantics: absence is unknown unless an explicit lifecycle or suspension fact explains it
daily.date_semantics: trade_date is the represented exchange session

units.suspend_timing: empty means full-day; intraday values unsupported

suspend_d.missing_semantics: absence is not evidence of normal trading
suspend_d.date_semantics: trade_date is the suspension event session

stk_limit.missing_semantics: missing row or incomplete pair is unknown, not no-limit

dividend.missing_semantics: only div_proc=实施 is promoted; proposals/approvals remain frozen raw observations, while an implemented row needs an explicit ex/effective date and unsupported non-zero terms block the build
dividend.date_semantics: the endpoint request is security-only and may return every div_proc state; canonical mapping separately promotes implemented rows while announcement, record, ex, pay, and listing dates remain distinct
dividend.terminal_history_risk: current terminal history is observed/best_effort, not verified PIT

field_mapping.factor: adj_factor passthrough; ratio interpreted only with explicit anchor

adj_factor.terminal_history_risk: factor revisions and original availability unknown

index_daily.date_semantics: trade_date is the represented exchange session

daily_basic.date_semantics: trade_date is the represented observation session
